name: Auramancer
description: A radiant support caster who projects powerful auras that bolster allies while wielding light-based attacks. Auras reserve mana — the more active, the less MP available for active skills.
lore: The Auramancers of the Crystal Spire learn to weave ambient magical energy into persistent fields of power. Their auras are not spells that fade — they are constant emanations that reshape the battlefield as long as the caster maintains concentration.

abilities.name: Radiant Pulse
abilities.description: A burst of radiant energy. Basic holy attack.

abilities.name: Aura of Might
abilities.description: AURA (reserves 15 MP): All allies deal 12% more physical and magic damage while active.

abilities.name: Radiant Nova
abilities.description: Releases a burst of radiant energy hitting all enemies for 0.7x holy damage. Heals all allies for 15% of damage dealt.

abilities.name: Aura of Warding
abilities.description: AURA (reserves 20 MP): All allies gain 8% physical resistance and 6% damage reduction.

abilities.name: Prismatic Bolt
abilities.description: Prismatic AoE that damages all enemies and reduces their DEF by 10% for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Aura of Restoration
abilities.description: AURA (reserves 25 MP): All allies regenerate 8 HP and 3 MP per turn.

abilities.name: Resonance
abilities.description: Passive: All aura effects are 25% stronger. +20 max MP.

abilities.name: Transcendent Burst
abilities.description: Ultimate: Massive holy AoE. Heals party for 25% of damage dealt. All party stats +15% for 3 turns.

synergies: Warrior: Aura of Warding + Shield Wall makes the Warrior nearly unkillable
Mage: Aura of Might boosts the Mage's already high magic damage
Witch: Auramancer buffs while Witch debuffs — enemies crushed from both sides
weaknesses: Low personal damage — relies on empowering allies
Active auras reduce available MP for active abilities
Fragile if focused — low STR and moderate STA
Needs a party to be useful — terrible solo
hire_description: A figure in flowing white and gold robes sits cross-legged, eyes closed. The air around them shimmers with visible energy — warmth, clarity, power. They open their eyes. "I do not fight your battles. I make your warriors fight harder, your mages cast truer, your shields hold stronger."
